renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Five refusals charged — speak, see, hear, come, support — and scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free.

paragraphs.text: Here is the complaint, five times over: You do not speak to me. You do not look at me. You do not hear my begging. You do not come into my mind. You do not hold me up when I fall. And here is the twist: the holy books take that whole complaint and turn it into a teaching — of course He does none of those things. He has no speech, no sight, no hearing, no feet to come with.

paragraphs.text: Five charges filed: no speech, no look, no hearing, no coming, no support. Then scripture flips the charge sheet into doctrine: sense-free is what He is. Complaint becomes teaching.
